thread:
Maria G.: Planning thread 1: We need a tight playbook that links our benchmark narratives to persona-focused hooks and concrete inbound routing rules for the upcoming launch webinar. Deliverables: two benchmark callout slides + one-page SDR cheat sheet by EOD Wed. Keep it lean.

Akash P.: Agreed. Target personas Id prioritize: Platform Engineers (latency, p99, tail), Product/Growth (dev DX, time-to-market), Security/Compliance leads (private deploys, KMS & audit).

Neal R.: For Platform Eng, the strongest claim is stability under long-context: our latest runs show ~35-45% p99 improvement vs ManagedX at 4k tokens under bursty load. I can produce the flame graph + latency distribution. Will validate numbers.

Jon S.: Webinar theme idea: "Serving-First Inference: predictable performance without lock-in" 1. Demo plan: 8min live walkthrough, 7min failover/canary scenario, 10min Q&A. Use a short SaaS spike scenario (checkout flows spiking during sale). Save deep technical dives for the breakout.

Maria G.: Routing map: high-intent signups -> AE; technical compliance signals -> Solutions Eng; lower-intent -> nurture. Need exact mapping rules for Segment -> HubSpot.

Akash P.: Draft routing rules (YAML-style pseudocode):

```
source: webinar_signup
rules:
  - condition: (company_size >= 1000) OR (email_domain in enterprise_list)
    action: route:ae-enterprise
  - condition: contains(usage_intent, 'infrastructure') OR contains(usage_intent, 'private')
    action: route:solutions-eng
  - condition: engagement_score >= 50 AND within_hours(72)
    action: route:sdr-priority
  - default:
    action: route:marketing-drip
```

We'll implement as Segment traits -> HubSpot workflow. Any missing edge cases?

Neal R.: Add: if attendee checks "request full benchmark" OR uploads a prompt set -> route:solutions-eng (tag: eval-request). Also: if someone requests a post-webinar demo (within 7 days) -> escalate to SDR follow-up.

Maria G.: Perfect. Also need 3-line SDR hooks (persona-specific, claim-backed, CTA). Example for Platform Eng: "Reduce inference tail latency by ~40% for long-context workloads vs top managed endpoints  ask for our 2-min bench visual." Tone: short, factual, legal safe.

Jon S.: I'll draft the hooks and a 10-min webinar run-of-show. Also recommend including two landing page blurbs: (1) unit cost advantage on long-context tokens, (2) tail-latency resilience under spike. Link both to the benchmark appendix PDF.

Akash P.: I'll pull the bench harness outputs and make a single slide with latency CDF and cost-per-token delta. ETA Tue noon.

Neal R.: Requesting read access to bench logs for reproducible screenshots. @infra-oncall?

infra-oncall: Granted read access to bench-cluster-2026 for Neal R. and Akash P. until Wed EOD. :white_check_mark:

Maria G.: Action items recap:
- Jon S.: SDR hooks + run-of-show (due Tue 12:00)
- Akash P.: bench slide + routing rules (due Tue 12:00)
- Neal R.: verify bench claims + reproducible steps (due Tue 12:00)
- Maria G.: assemble 1-pager + SDR cheat (due Wed EOD)

Any blockers?

Neal R.: No blockers currently. Will re-run bench if we need to tighten the tail numbers.

Maria G.: Ok scheduled sync Tue 11:00 to merge assets and finalize HubSpot mapping. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
